title: Rig Relay Operation v1
description: Content-light operation record representing a Relay session or operation. Derived from Rig's Workspace/Operation vocabulary. No raw prompts, model outputs, source code, diffs, stdout/stderr bodies, secrets, tokens, API keys, or raw private paths.

operation_kind.description: Kind of operation (e.g. session, intent, validation, checkpoint, spawn).

created_at.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when the operation was created.

updated_at.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when the operation was last updated.

lane_id.description: Optional lane/child-session identifier this operation belongs to.

parent_operation_id.description: Optional parent operation identifier for hierarchical operations.

intent_id.description: Optional intent identifier that triggered this operation.

progress_event_refs.description: References (SHA256) to progress events associated with this operation.

receipt_refs.description: References (SHA256) to authorization receipts associated with this operation.

sha256.description: SHA256 content hash of the artifact.

artifact_refs.description: Content-light artifact references associated with this operation.

warnings.description: Human-readable warnings about the operation or its data.

content_light_guarantee.description: Guarantee that the record contains no raw content.
